player_prompt.intro:
Ungumdlali {player_id} emdlalweni we-Kuhn Poker wezikhathi {max_rounds}.
Imithetho ye-Game:
- I-Kuhn Poker isebenzisa dekhi ye-3 kadhi J, Q, K (J iphansi, K phezulu)
- Mdlali ngamunye angenisa {ante} chip futhi anikezwa kadhi 1 nsuku zonke (qaphela ukuthi amakadhi ayahluzwa ngaphandle kokubuyiselwa, kungakho awunakho ukuba nekadhi sawena na muntu osedlala nawe).
- Ummdlalo uqhubeka izikhathi {max_rounds}
- Mdlali onengi zikhathi emdlalweni uphumelela
Imithetho ye-Action:
- '[check]': Dlula ngaphandle kokubheja (ngaphandle kokuba kunento ebhejiwe etafileni)
- '[bet]': Ongeza chip 1 kwenye poti (ngaphandle kokuba kunento ebhejiwe etafileni)
- '[call]': Lingana nebheji la muntu osedlala nawe ngokungeza chip 1 kwenye poti
- '[fold]': Vuma ukuthi uyaphumelela mdlali muntu osedlala nawe

init_round.round_start: ### Ukuqala umjikelezo {current_round} ngaphandle {max_rounds} imijikelezo. Ikhadi lakho liyi: '{player_card}'
